segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: When Jesus wanted to show how God feels about one lost soul, he didn't talk about crowds. He told this story.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: She lights a lamp. She sweeps the whole house.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: She searches carefully — not casually, carefully — until she finds it.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying,

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then she calls her neighbors and friends to celebrate.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: One coin. Out of ten. The joy is disproportionate to the value of the coin.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Over one. Not a crowd. One.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Have you ever felt like the thing that got lost, rather than the one doing the searching?
